question: Which categories have an above-average profit ratio but below-average sales?

cat_agg = df.groupby('Category').agg(
    Total_Sales=('Total_Sales', 'sum'),
    Total_Profit=('Profit', 'sum')
).reset_index()

cat_agg['Profit_Ratio'] = cat_agg['Total_Profit'] / cat_agg['Total_Sales']

avg_sales = cat_agg['Total_Sales'].mean()
avg_ratio = cat_agg['Profit_Ratio'].mean()

result = cat_agg[
    (cat_agg['Profit_Ratio'] > avg_ratio) & 
    (cat_agg['Total_Sales'] < avg_sales)
]
